observations.summary: proposed framework requires claim-scoped validation and frozen partitions and forbids moving failed holdouts into calibration while retaining holdout language
benchmark contract separates predictive comparison from causal interpretation and requires frozen feature/partition choices

claims.proposition: World Zero methodology permits an unqualified WORLD_ZERO_VALIDATED claim.
claims.rationale: The validation strategy explicitly says never to state WORLD_ZERO_VALIDATED without a qualifier and separates multiple validation claims.
claims.claim_ceiling: Methodological policy finding; not a result about a specific model run.

claims.proposition: World Zero methodology permits failed holdout data to be moved into calibration while continuing to call it holdout evidence.
claims.rationale: The frozen-partition section explicitly prohibits that practice.

claims.proposition: These audited methodology/benchmark documents by themselves establish real-world predictive validity of World Zero.
claims.rationale: The files are framework/contracts and define how validation should occur; they are not themselves a bound predictive-result receipt for a specific model, dataset, and holdout.
claims.claim_ceiling: No model-performance conclusion from framework source alone.

limitations: No specific World Zero run receipt was selected as the subject of this case.
